name: VC Dimension of Addressing
details: Scope: complete-code subfamily $n=2^r$, $r\ge1$. The displayed formula is not asserted for arbitrary injective encodings at other n.
proof: Restrict here to $n=2^r$ with all r-bit words present, so $\lfloor\log_2n\rfloor=\log_2n=r$. The address coordinates realize every binary pattern, so they form a shattered set of size $\lfloor\log n\rfloor$. Since the class has exactly $2^{\lfloor\log n\rfloor}$ concepts, no larger set can be shattered.
